name: Region 4: Shogun Fortress
purpose: Background artwork for Region 4 of the Achievement World Map.
visual: Massive multi-tiered fortress on mountain peak with crimson war banners.
prompt: A minimalist 2D graphic illustration of a world map region. A massive multi-tiered black samurai castle fortress on a jagged mountain peak, red war banners along the battlements, giant solid crimson-red sun backdrop, pitch black sky, clean vector edges, no anime, no 3D, no text.
